text:
Alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners and dates for the GPU capacity fixes. TL;DR: quota request, scheduler knob tuning, 72h soak with dashboards, and alert guardrails. Proposed owners: Priya (quota), Devon (scheduler), Mika (soak). Thoughts?

Priya: I can take the quota request. Need exact numbers and a preferred window for the increase.

Devon: Recommend a staged approach: 1) quota dry-run (no actual bump) to validate scheduler behavior, 2) 80% headroom soak, 3) bump if soak stable. Also watch fair-share and preemption.

Sam: +1. Can we canary by region (us-east -> us-west)? That reduces blast radius.

Mika: I'll own the soak plan and dashboards. I'll add metrics for p95/p99 latency, backlog size, and preempt_rate.

Alex: OK — propose timeline: plan by 3 business days, dry-run week after, soak start 2025-05-02, soak end 2025-05-05, rollback window 24h after soak. Agree?

Priya: Dates work for me. I'll draft the quota request for the support ticket.

IncidentBot: Created INC-4021 (gpu-quota-request) assigned to Priya, due 2025-05-01.

Devon: For scheduler knobs I want to test two params: `fair_share_weight=0.88` and `preempt_threshold=0.58`. We'll run the dry-run with `scheduler.debug=true` to capture traces.

Alex: Add explicit pre/post metrics we care about: p99 latency, queue length, preempt_rate, eviction_count, and successful_scheduling_ratio.

Mika: Dashboard links I'll attach to the tickets. Proposed alert to add during soak: `alerts/gpu_backlog_rate > 10% for 5m` and `alerts/p99_latency > 2s for 3m`.

Priya: We'll need cloud quota approval too — @Sam can you own the cloud support side (ticket escalation)?

Sam: Yep, I'll open the cloud support case after INC-4021 lands. ETA 24h for initial response, escalate if needed.

Priya: Also adding a dry-run script to the runbook for reproducibility. Example:

```
# simulate sustained generation load for dry-run
python tools/sim_load.py --qps 1200 --dur 3h --model model-xl --trace scheduler
```

Devon: During the soak we'll enable `scheduler.debug=true` for the first hour, then flip back. Also keep `preempt_protection=on` for low-priority jobs.

Mika: I'll schedule a recurring 30m check-in during the 72h soak (daily at 9:30am). Adding calendar invite now.

Alex: Let's create explicit rollback steps in the ticket: who runs the rollback, what command, and indicators to trigger rollback.

Priya: Draft rollback: revert quota change, rollback scheduler config to previous commit, and drain new nodes. I'll add commands to the ticket.

Sam: I'll add cloud-side rollback steps (revoke quota, shrink node pool).

IncidentBot: Created INC-4022 (scheduler-tuning) assigned to Devon, due 2025-05-02.

IncidentBot: Created INC-4023 (gpu-soak-dashboard) assigned to Mika, due 2025-05-05.

Devon: Risk notes — bumping quota without soak can create unfair weight to long-running jobs. We'll monitor `fair_share_imbalance` metric and have an automated rollback if it exceeds threshold.

Alex: Good call. Add that auto-rollback clause to INC-4021 with thresholds.

Mika: Added dashboard snapshots and the alert rules to INC-4023. Link: https://redwood-internal/grafana/d/soak-gpu (will add full link in ticket).

Priya: I'll update the internal runbook with the exact timeline and owners. Will ping when INC-4021 is submitted.

Alex: Thanks — final checklist for today: Priya submits quota ticket, Devon posts scheduler change plan + rollback commands, Mika wires dashboards and alerts, Sam owns cloud support & rollback ops. We'll reconvene tomorrow 09:00 to confirm tickets and kickoff dry-run. :thumbsup:

Sam: Got it.

Mika: calendar invite sent.

Priya: filing now.

Devon: preparing config diffs.

Alex: Great, appreciate the quick turnaround.
